Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams, suppliers, and technology partners to ensure architectural consistency. Conduct change impact assessments and evaluate the effects of modifications on vehicle-level systems. Maintain requirements traceability and ensure consistency across the complete vehicle architecture. Support engineering development processes and contribute to continuous improvements in system design and integration. Requirements The ideal candidate combines a strong engineering background with hands-on experience in automotive E/E systems, systems architecture, and requirements engineering. You should be comfortable managing complex technical interfaces, working with multidisciplinary teams, and applying relevant automotive standards and development methodologies. Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics, Automotive Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline. Several years of experience in E/E systems development within the automotive or off-highway industry. Strong understanding of vehicle E/E architectures, systems engineering, and requirements engineering. Familiarity with automotive communication technologies, including CAN/CAN-FD, LIN, Automotive Ethernet, and UDS diagnostics. Experience with architecture and requirements management tools such as PREEvision, DOORS, Enterprise Architect, MATLAB/Simulink, or comparable MBSE/SysML-based solutions.
